resources.string: Optional nudges to log body data regularly: a weigh-in on the days you choose and a monthly measuring round for circumferences. Nothing is sent when today\'s value is already logged, and a reminder never counts against you when you skip it.
Same time as the weigh-in reminder.
Notifications are off for CruxCoach. The reminders stay saved but cannot appear – you can allow notifications in the Android settings.
The trend counts, not the single value. Tap to log it.
Log your circumferences? Takes two minutes – skip it whenever you like.
What you can do per exercise – the basis for planned loads.
